items.title: File Widerspruch against sick-pay refusal
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, sent by ordinary post by a social-insurance body. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X (as also stated in the letter itself: 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben'), it counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: 27.01.2026 + 4 days = 31.01.2026 (a Saturday; for this deemed-delivery rule the day itself is not shifted). The one-month Widerspruch period of § 84 Abs. 1 SGG starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X): 01.02.2026, and ends one month later under § 188 Abs. 2/3 BGB on 28.02.2026, a Saturday. Under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X the deadline shifts to the next business day: Monday 02.03.2026.

warnings: The letter states sick pay (Krankengeld) is paid only from 22.01.2026 instead of 12.01.2026 because the incapacity notice arrived late (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V); if the person believes it was reported on time or the delay was not their fault, this is the point to dispute within the Widerspruch deadline.
